column1: # Curated words for kids: concrete things everybody names the same way when
# they see the picture. One concept per line:
# "-" = leave out in that language (no clear word there).
# "a|b" = the app says "a", "b" is accepted too (the picture suggests both).
# Rules: no abstract words, no phrases; every common word for the picture
# must be listed (e.g. 🥕 Karotte|Möhre), otherwise a child saying the other
